text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- British hotels and leisure group Granada Group Plc agreed to sell its motorway service station network to Bahrain-based Investcorp for 476 million stg.
- Two British vocational planning specialists arrived in Bahrain to assist the Labour and Social Affairs Ministry in the introduction of national vocational training in Bahrain.
- Bahrain is revamping a 22-year-old law on companies to spur economic growth.
- Officials from Gulf Arab states are to hold a meeting in Bahrain to discuss ways to ease labour movement between them.
- Labour minister said Bahrain spennt 45 million dinars on training programmes.
